messages:
maria-docs: FYI I opened a PR with the KMS migration guide + SDK snippets. It includes a small example that currently shows a fake key inline, but legal wants us to redact and add a note about CMK policies before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6172

sam-eng: thanks — saw the preview. docs-bot says deploy preview is up: https://deploy-preview-6172--redwood-docs.netlify.app/guides/kms-migration

alex-security: quick look — the snippet uses `apiKey = "AKIA..."` which we should never show. also add a pointer to the KMS least-privilege policy.

maria-docs: ok i'll remove the inline key and replace with `process.env.REDWOOD_KMS_KEY` in the snippet. is that enough for legal? @jen-legal can you confirm what wording you want around redaction/retention?

jen-legal: Thanks. We need: 1) no real or realistic secrets in examples, 2) a short paragraph about who can access CMKs in our model, and 3) a note about audit logging. If those are in place I'm fine. :+1:

sam-eng: CI currently has a docs link-checker failure on the KMS policy anchor — `404 anchor not found`. ci-bot posted details: `https://ci.internal.redwood/6172/links`

ci-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link found in docs/guides/kms-migration.md -> anchor `#kms-iam-policy` missing in docs/security/kms.md

maria-docs: thanks CI. i'll fix the anchor and drop the example secret. Also adding the legal paragraph. Will push an update in ~30m.

alex-security: when you update, please add this snippet to show use of env var + minimal perms example (short):
```
const client = new KMSClient({ region: process.env.AWS_REGION });
const keyId = process.env.REDWOOD_KMS_KEY; // don't hardcode
```

maria-docs: adding that now. Also adding a TODO for a follow-up to include KMS rotation guidance (separate PR).

jen-legal: quick follow — can we put the legal paragraph under a collapsed note block? We want it prominent but not to bloat the quickstart.

maria-docs: yes i'll use the docs note component and reference audit logging + access control.

sam-eng: timing question — this PR is touching a lot of infra-sensitive text. Any objection to merging during our low-traffic window tonight (02:00 PT)? We need approvals + CI green.

jen-legal: approve pending the redaction & anchor fix. No problem with the 02:00 PT merge window.

alex-security: approve pending removal of inline key and addition of minimal perms line. happy for 02:00 PT as well.

maria-docs: pushed fixes: removed inline key, added env-var snippet, fixed anchor, added legal note. New commit -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6172/commits/5f3a8

ci-bot: all checks passed ✅ (link-checker, lint, preview build). Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-6172--redwood-docs.netlify.app/guides/kms-migration

sam-eng: merging at 02:00 PT unless someone flags. I'll do the merge and monitor the console.

jen-legal: thanks everyone — marking as approved.

maria-docs: thanks! will open the follow-up PR for rotation guidance in the morning. :wave:
